<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Ship the permanent composition-warning path first: correct PM integration reaches actual checks, with deviations recorded and visible to independent review. No declaration or consumer-specific bypass; preserve integrity refusals and prior evidence. Detailed implementation tasks are not issued at the product-planning stage.
